# Topological_Invariant_Shift

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A change in a topological invariant (e.g., winding number or connectivity) of the swarmalator system's interaction graph as parameters vary. Provides a robust, noise-resistant signal for triggering reconfiguration in TCC, ensuring computational stability under dynamic conditions.
